P1.quote: They don't allow any code, installs or stack choices until you approve two plans, so this first step is understanding what you need.

P2.quote: Where does the money go? Does each gym get paid straight into its own account, with you charging a fee or subscription? Or do you collect everything and pay the gyms?

P3.quote: This assumes: each gym is paid directly, unlimited monthly membership, trainers mark attendance, one shared app, owners on a computer, and a small team that works in TypeScript.

P4.quote: | Marketing site | ⏸ Later | Needed once you start selling to gyms |

P5.quote: Each gym's data must stay separate from the others; I'll treat that as a must-pass check before release.

P6.quote: | Payments | Stripe Billing + Stripe Connect; card details never touch your servers | One central Stripe account if you collect the money yourself (question 1) |

P7.quote: Then I'll finalize the applications and technology for your approval.
